title: Once Upon A Tide I Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Once Upon A Tide is a 1 BR / 1 BA / 4 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. This lock off is located on beautiful Seaside Avenue just one block to town center and a short walk to the beach. It has a very private side entrance with a large welcoming front porch.
description_expanded: Description142 SEASIDE AVENUE1 KING LOFT BEDROOM* Construction Notice - Third-party construction is occurring on an adjacent lot across from this residence and may be visible or audible during permitted hours. In Seaside, Florida, construction hours are Monday–Saturday, 8 AM–6 PM. Please contact the Homeowner’s Collection team at 1-855-411-1557 to inquire on construction details.Once Upon a Tide 1 | Prime Seaside Avenue LocationOnce Upon a Tide 1 is a spacious one-bedroom lock-off ideally located on iconic Seaside Avenue, just one block from the town center and a short stroll to Seaside’s sugar-white beaches. This charming coastal retreat offers both privacy and convenience, making it an excellent choice for couples or small families seeking a walkable Seaside vacation rental.Outdoor Living & Private PorchGuests enter through a private side entrance that opens onto a large, welcoming front porch overlooking a peaceful, landscaped yard framed by classic white picket fencing. Furnished with an outdoor dining table that seats eight, this open-air porch is perfect for al fresco meals, morning coffee, or evening cocktails while enjoying the quiet surroundings and coastal breeze.Open Living, Dining & Kitchen AreaInside, the home features an open and inviting living space with a mounted flat-screen TV, seamlessly connected to the dining and kitchen areas. The dining table comfortably seats four, while the kitchen breakfast bar provides additional seating for four more. The full-size kitchen is well equipped with stainless steel appliances, ample cabinetry, and cookware—ideal for both short stays and extended Seaside getaways.King Loft Bedroom & Private BalconyUpstairs, the king primary loft bedroom offers a serene retreat complete with a full bathroom featuring a tub and shower combination. Just off the loft, a spacious private open-air balcony provides seating for two and overlooks the treetops, landscaped yard, brick-paved Seaside streets, and charming white picket fences. This tranquil space is perfect for reading, relaxing, or enjoying a quiet afternoon escape.Once Upon a Tide 1 is a much larger one-bedroom lock-off escape for couples located on a quiet corner of Seaside Avenue and Savannah Street. Need a little more space? Be sure and check out the additional two-bedroom lock-off option, Once Upon a Tide 2.(Please be advised that some exterior areas of this home are under video surveillance. HVAC thermostat is locked to not allow air conditioning temperature to be set below 68.)* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURESFeatures 576 square feet4-minute walk or 352 yards to beach access at Savannah Pavilion; largest residential private beaches on 30A Located on Seaside AvenueOutdoor showerCharcoal Grill Stackable Washer and dryerNetflix accessPeacock Alley Linens featuring fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to Seaside amenities including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis & 3 pickleball courts court fees apply, and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedOne parking pass is issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002215
